title: senna hirsuta var. glaberrima
intro: Senna hirsuta var. glaberrima, commonly known as glabrous senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include the relief of constipation and other digestive issues due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna hirsuta var. glaberrima are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and rhein, which have been identified as the primary bioactive compounds in this plant.
